name: Atharva
source:
A mysterious young man who escaped from a certain facility owned by the government.
Following the words of his dead older brother he goes to find [url=/c48267]Eve[/url] and ends up meeting [url=/c48269]Sud[/url].

Ever since he was born he's had memories from hundreds of years ago that aren't his. He thinks Eve is the key to unlocking the mystery of those memories.
